name: lifecycle-migration-rest
title: Migrate remaining lifecycle owners
description: Migrate the remaining lifecycle owners to QuiescenceScope: CaptureLifecycle / LayeredCaptureRunner / MultiAdapterCaptureLoop / IdleExpirySweeper / RuntimeHeartbeat, plus the SOCKS5 control connection (Socks5UdpTransport gets only an allocation-free guard). NdisCapturePump is deliberately unchanged (the primitive is internal to WinForward.Runtime and the dependency direction forbids the reverse) and is documented as out of scope. Completing this child empties the C2 analyzer allowlist.
